title: HR onboarding portal
summary: An onboarding app: request a new starter in a side panel, track each starter’s checklist, see every team’s onboarding tasks and the start dates on a calendar.
description:
HR onboarding portal is a ready-made app that gets new starters ready for day one. A hiring manager opens it from the Apps menu, presses New starter and fills in the New starter request in a panel that slides in from the right: name, job title, department, manager, start date, location, employment type and equipment.

Each request starts the New starter onboarding workflow. The starter is added to the New starters table and four items to the Onboarding checklist (IT, Facilities, People team, Manager). IT, Facilities and the People team then get a task each, and the manager gets one to plan the first week; every task is due on the start date. Completing a task ticks off its checklist item and moves the starter’s progress on by 25%.

The app has five pages: Home (the main buttons, starters in the pipeline, average checklist progress on a gauge, open tasks, progress per starter and who is joining soon), Checklist (items by status, items per team and status, and the checklist grid grouped by starter), Team tasks (your tasks, tasks per person and a Kanban board), Start dates (a month calendar of the tasks due on each start date beside the starter list) and Resources (manager links and how onboarding works). Six sample starters and their checklists make it useful straight after install.
start: Open Onboarding portal from the Apps menu and press New starter; the request form opens in a side panel and starts the onboarding workflow.
setup: Open Apps → Onboarding portal → Settings → Audience: add hiring managers and the IT, Facilities and People teams as contributors.
Assignees: pick who in IT, Facilities and the People team prepares each new starter (one person per step; change them to teams later). The manager step goes to the manager chosen on each request.
Edit the locations, departments and equipment on the New starter request form.
Replace the links on the Resources page with your own guides, and delete the sample starters when you go live.
